name: The Last Love Letter
detailed_description:
🕊️💌 A lost letter. A wounded pigeon. A war on the verge of silencing everything.

Antonio is a carrier pigeon who, after being struck by lightning during a storm, wakes up amidst the wreckage of war. His satchel is empty — the letters he was carrying scattered into the chaos. Now, even while injured, he sets out on a journey to recover them, flying through thorny forests, bombed cities, and forgotten frontlines.

But these aren't just letters. They carry memories, farewells, and promises from missing soldiers. What begins as a delivery mission slowly unfolds into an emotional journey of loss, resilience, and hope.

Features

💌 Tight platforming with diverse challenges – Control Antonio through fluid, responsive gameplay filled with spikes, collapsing platforms, trampolines, and many other obstacles.

💌 A quiet and symbolic narrative – Each level reveals fragments of untold stories, through unique characters and moments where silence speaks louder than words.

💌 Retro visuals with soul – 8-bit inspired pixel art enhanced by an optional nostalgic filter for extra immersion.

💌 Emotional chiptune soundtrack – Original compositions that blend tension and tenderness, crafted with authentic retro sounds.

💌 100+ intense challenge screens – Face a long and varied journey packed with surprises and escalating difficulty.

💌 Memorable characters – Meet striking figures like a disillusioned hedgehog... and many others.

A letter may not change the course of a war...

But it can change whoever reads it.
